tagline: Selected text → a ready AI prompt, secrets masked

slides.title: Turn any selection into a ready AI prompt
slides.text: Select text, press Alt+P or right-click → Pastebot, pick what you want done.

slides.title: Secrets masked before prompting
slides.text: Emails, API keys, cards, tokens and home paths become placeholders like [EMAIL_1]. Review what was masked, undo it for one prompt.

slides.title: Copy, or copy and open your AI
slides.text: ChatGPT and Perplexity open with the prompt filled in; Claude and Gemini are ready to paste.

slides.title: Compose, then find it again
slides.text: The popup has the same numbered actions. History is one tab away; search and pins are Pro.

slides.title: Your own templates, with variables
slides.text: {title}, {url} and {date} fill in; {{Audience}} is asked when you run it. Import and export as JSON.
